verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents several selectable transcription options: Realtime vs Batch processing and Agent STT (docs-1, docs-2, docs-3), domain-specialized models such as finance or medical requested via the language config (docs-27), and multilingual and medical models listed on its pricing page (docs-31, docs-32). However, the evidence shows no published side-by-side accuracy, latency, or cost tradeoffs between these options. The accuracy comparisons that exist are against competitors (Deepgram, Whisper), not between Speechmatics' own models (docs-16, docs-17). missing for 10: published per-model accuracy/WER figures, per-model latency figures, per-model pricing, an explicit model-selection tradeoff guide, independent corroboration.
